descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
ALTEN Romania, part of the international ALTEN Group - with a unique position as a Leader in IT and engineering Consulting - has supported its clients’ development strategies in innovation, R&D, and IT systems since 1996.
 A typical day might include the following: 
Develop and maintain backend features using PHP and CodeIgniter.
Implement new application modules and enhance existing functionality.
Update frontend interfaces and resolve UI-related issues.
Extend the existing API and support the migration of existing interactions to API-based functionality.
Write and maintain SQL queries and work with relational databases.
Create and maintain automated tests using PHPUnit.
Investigate and resolve bugs across the application.
Refactor existing code and contribute to application security improvements.
Maintain and adapt CI/CD workflows using Azure Pipelines.
Contribute to task estimation and weekly planning, follow through on delivery commitments, and communicate potential blockers.
Support occasional updates to legacy components when required.
 To ensure success in this role, you need the following experience and skills: 
Solid professional experience in PHP application development and maintenance.
Hands-on experience with CodeIgniter or a strong PHP framework background with the ability to adapt quickly.
Practical frontend development experience and the ability to work across both backend and user interface tasks.
Experience developing and integrating APIs.
Good knowledge of SQL and relational databases.
Experience with automated unit testing, ideally using PHPUnit.
Working knowledge of Linux and Docker.
Familiarity with CI/CD workflows.
Ability to understand an existing codebase, troubleshoot issues and deliver tasks autonomously.
Good communication, collaboration, and task estimation skills.
 Nice to have: 
Knowledge of C#, Visual Basic and DevExpress for occasional work on legacy components.
Familiarity with Python, DevExpress
